privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: At My Call Insurance, your privacy is very important to us. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, and protect your information when you use our website and services.
privacy.collectText: We may collect personal information such as your name, phone number, email address, and other details voluntarily provided through contact forms or service requests.
privacy.useText: The information we collect is used to provide personalized services, respond to inquiries, improve customer support, and comply with legal requirements.
privacy.shareText: We do not sell or share your personal information with third parties except when necessary to provide our services, comply with the law, or with your prior consent.
privacy.cookiesText: Our website may use cookies to enhance user experience, analyze traffic, and personalize content. You can disable cookies through your browser settings.
privacy.securityText: We implement reasonable security measures to protect your personal information. However, no system is completely secure and absolute protection cannot be guaranteed.
privacy.childrenText: Our services are intended only for individuals 18 years of age or older. We do not knowingly collect information from minors.
privacy.rightsText: You have the right to access, correct, or request deletion of your personal information in accordance with applicable laws.
privacy.contactText: If you have any questions about this Privacy Policy, please contact us through the information provided on this website.

teamSection.maryFull:
With a deep commitment to her community, Mary Bornachera founded My Call Insurance Agency to provide trustworthy, personalized, and heart-driven insurance solutions.

With nearly fifteen years of experience in the industry, she takes pride in helping individuals, families, and businesses feel secure in their coverage—no matter what life brings. She specializes in Medicare, the Affordable Care Act (ACA), and life insurance.

At My Call Insurance, Mary believes in honest guidance, strong relationships, and putting your needs first, because protecting what matters most is always just a call away.
teamSection.carlosFull:
Carlos Montoya is a dedicated insurance professional with a strong focus on Affordable Care Act (ACA) plans and health coverage solutions.

As Co-Founder of My Call Insurance Agency, he combines industry expertise with a passion for helping individuals and families find affordable and accessible insurance options. Carlos is known for his honest and straightforward approach, always taking the time to clearly explain coverage so clients can make confident, informed decisions.

His commitment to trust, transparency, and exceptional service is the foundation of every conversation.
teamSection.linaFull:
With more than a decade of experience in corporate finance, Lina brings a strategic and personalized approach to My Call Insurance Agency.

She is dedicated to preserving and growing the family legacy through exceptional service and clear, reliable guidance for all insurance needs. Her passion lies in empowering the community through education, helping clients make informed decisions based on their individual circumstances.

Lina is committed to helping clients navigate their insurance needs with confidence while ensuring the continued growth and long-term impact of the agency.
teamSection.supportDesc: Our dedicated support team is here to simplify your insurance experience. We provide clear and compassionate guidance on Medicare, the Affordable Care Act (ACA), and commercial plans. Consider us your trusted resource for answers, information, and ongoing support.

whyAgent.title: Why an agent?
whyAgent.description: Working with a licensed insurance agent offers a personalized experience unlike anything you'll find when purchasing insurance on your own. Our agents simplify the process and help you find the best coverage tailored to your needs. Their support saves you time and helps you avoid costly mistakes, ensuring you make sound decisions for your future. Trust our agents to guarantee your peace of mind and that of your loved ones.
